# Server Rules

All Hail the server rules!!


## 1.: Be Respectful to others

Please stay respectful to others, no matter their race. Everyone should be treated the same way. If you start a fight, you get banned, no matter who you are

## 2.: Have Common sense

This is an important thing to mention: Just because a rule listed here doesnt contain specific information doesnt mean you should, e.g., spam the general channel with the n word

## 3.: Keep privacy.

This includes self-doxx aswell, were strangers on the internet, not someone to trust with your personal information

## 4.: Do not advertise unless you were approved by staff to do this

Do not advertise for your own discord server unless you got an explicit exception.

## 5.: Follow Discord's [Terms of Service](https://discord.com/terms) aswell as the [Community Guidelines](https://discord.com/guidelines)

Not doing so will get you banned both ways

## 6.: No NSFW, Illegal or harmful content

This includes:
* Gore
* S*xual content
* etc

## 7.: Keep messages on topic

send messages like bot commands in <#1451198686444126340>  and so on

## 8.: Keep channels in english

This server‘s main language is english, talking any other language makes it hard to moderate as a result. Please keep it english.
**PUNISHMENT CAN RANGE FROM A 1 DAY TIMEOUT TO A KICK**

Exceptions are: You getting explicit permission, are using the language channels or are using English morse


## 9.: No earrape, soundboard spam and similar


## 10.: No AI slop

If you send any videos/pictures containing AI Slop or brainrot content your message will be deleted alongside a 1 day timeout. Please note: The same counts for text
Also important: saying 67 gets you muted for 67 min

## 11.: Anything containing Phonk will be immediately removed

No exceptions

1472875653677322332.author: Frozy#8406
1472875653677322332.content:
Here's a quick run-through, assuming you mean the main game timeline. It's a bit of a mess, honestly.

*   **Circa 1985:** "The Missing Children Incident" happens at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza. Five kids disappear, later found stuffed into animatronics. This is like, the big one.
*   **Later Years (Exact order is fuzzy):**
    *   **FNaF 2:** A prequel, kinda. "The Bite of '87" happens here. More animatronics, more child murders. Joy.
    *   **FNaF 1:** The classic. You're a night guard at the original (or a revival) location. The possessed animatronics are doing their thing.
    *   **FNaF 3:** Set 30 years later. A horror attraction based on the old pizza place. You deal with the lingering "Springtrap."
    *   **FNaF 4:** Home invasion, but with nightmares. Features "The Bite of '83."
    *   **FNaF: Sister Location:** About a creepy underground pizza place with some *really* unsettling animatronics. Has a big lore dump.
    *   **Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator (FNaF 6):** Looks innocent, is not. It's about building your own pizzeria, but also about trapping and "salvaging" the animatronics.
    *   **Ultimate Custom Night:** A compilation of *everyone*. Essentially hell for the original killer.
    *   **Help Wanted (VR):** A meta-game. They're making a VR game about the FNAF games. Stuff gets weird and digital.
    *   **Security Breach:** Set way, way later. You're trapped in a giant mall with a killer animatronic. A lot of new lore.

**Important Notes:**

*   **William Afton:** The guy who did most of the bad stuff. He's the killer, the purple guy, Springtrap, Scraptrap, Burntrap... you get the idea.
*   **Remnant:** Some kind of soul-juice that keeps the animatronics going.
*   **The "Afton Family":** They're involved. A lot.
